ground_truth.explanation: builder.go line 658 calls `categoryExpander.Expand(arg)` with only one argument. After the interface change to require two arguments, this call fails to compile. fake.go (line 25) assigns `restmapper.SimpleCategoryExpander{}` to a `restmapper.CategoryExpander` variable, but SimpleCategoryExpander is updated in the same change to satisfy the new interface — so fake.go is not affected.
